career_ladder.note: Accounts Assistants serve in the Finance Department and Rural Development Department of Jammu and Kashmir under the Jammu & Kashmir Subordinate Accounts Service Rules, handling treasury accounting, budget maintenance, local fund auditing, and Public Financial Management System (PFMS) administration.

Subordinate Accounts Course (SAC Part-I) Promotion Regulations
J&K Public Service Commission SAC Part-II Examination Cadre Rules

steps.designation: Accounts Officer / Chief Accounts Officer (AO / CAO - Gazetted)
steps.source_label: J&K Accounts (Gazetted) Service Rules & Finance Department Senior Structure

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Accounts Assistant (Finance) is conducted via a single-stage OMR Based Written Examination (120 marks, 120 minutes) followed by Document Verification. Negative marking is 0.25 marks per incorrect answer.

stages.source_label: JKSSB FAA Examination Syllabus & Blueprint (Notification No. 04 of 2020)

papers.paper_name: General Knowledge with special reference to UT of J&K
Accountancy and Book Keeping (Principles, Ledger, Trial Balance, Cash Book, Financial Statements, Depreciation, Audit)
Mathematics (Set Theory, Relations, Matrices, Determinants, Differentiation)
General Economics (Fiscal Policy, Monetary Policy, GDP, National Income)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Single composite paper of 120 marks / 120 minutes; overall merit determines selection

stages.source_label: JKSSB Document Verification Notification for Accounts Assistant

papers.paper_name: Verification of Degree Certificate (Commerce/Science/Arts with requisite percentage), Domicile & Category Documents

financial_package.note: Accounts Assistants are appointed in Pay Matrix Level 5 (₹29,200–₹92,300 with Entry Basic Pay ₹29,200) under the Jammu and Kashmir Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules (S.O. 192 of 2020).
financial_package.pay_source_label: J&K Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules Schedule Level 5
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 5 entry basic pay of ₹29,200 at 58% DA (₹16,936 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 18%: ₹2,628 to ₹5,256), Medical Allowance (₹300), Transport Allowance (₹1,800 + DA = ₹2,844), net of NPS deduction (10% of Basic+DA = ₹4,614) and State Insurance.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually aligned with Central Government rates
House Rent Allowance (HRA) categorized across Jammu/Srinagar urban and district treasuries
Fixed Medical Allowance / cashless medical treatment under government health insurance
Subordinate accounts training sponsorship and examination incentives for SAC qualification
Defined contributory pension benefits under National Pension System (NPS)
Standard 3% annual basic increment in Pay Matrix Level 5
